headline: ADI internship assigns ML models for analog design automation and pipeline ADC evaluation
fact: Analog Devices posted a Mixed Signal Engineer Intern role for Wilmington and Durham. The student develops and validates machine-learning models for analog design automation, analyzes design, simulation and layout metrics, and builds scripts and tools to improve design flows. The role also assigns analog/mixed-signal circuit design, simulation and verification, physical-design optimization, and pipeline ADC lab evaluation and debug. Python with scikit-learn or PyTorch is requested. Official JobPosting metadata dates R265299 August 20. The role does not specifically assign RNM generation or AI-based UVM regression triage.
